Curaçao Turtle Monitoring Workflow

Sea turtle conservation in Curaçao depends on consistent monitoring of nesting beaches and field encounters. This workflow pulls nesting surveys, hatching inspections, nest relocations, and turtle encounter records from EarthRanger and produces a dashboard of maps, time series, and hatching success tables — broken down by species, beach, and nest manipulation type.

Dashboard

Before you begin, you'll need

  • An EarthRanger account for the Curaçao site, with a username and password.

Workflow Template

In the navigation bar, click Workflow Templates. On the Select a Workflow Template page, click the Add Workflow Template button in the top right corner of that page.

Paste in the workflow's GitHub link:

https://github.com/wildlife-dynamics/Curacao-Turtle_Monitoring

Then click Add Template. Curaçao Turtle Monitoring is now added to your workflow library, ready for you to configure and run against your EarthRanger data.

Data Source

Click Data Sources in the navigation bar, then click Connect Data Source in the top right.

Fill in:

  • Data Source Name — a name for this connection, e.g. Curaçao
  • EarthRanger URL — your site's subdomain (the .pamdas.org part is added automatically)
  • EarthRanger Username and EarthRanger Password — your login credentials

Then click Connect.

Heads up: your credentials aren't checked when you hit Connect. If something's wrong, you won't find out until you actually try running a workflow against it.

Open Your Workflow

Find the Curaçao-Turtle_Monitoring card under My Workflows and click it. This opens its configuration form, starting with the details below.

Now that setup is done

Workflow Configuration

The rest of this guide walks through the workflow's own configuration form, section by section, in the order it appears on the page.

Workflow Details

  • Workflow Name — required. Identifies this run in My Workflows and at the top of its dashboard.
  • Workflow Description — optional free-text note for yourself or a teammate.

Data Source

Select the EarthRanger connection you added in the setup steps. This tells the workflow which site's records to pull.

Time Range

Sets the window of events this run analyzes, and the timezone every timestamp is interpreted in. Dates throughout the dashboard are displayed in the format DD Mon YYYY (e.g. 01 Jan 2025).

Match the Timezone to Curaçao's locale (America/Curacao) to ensure time-based groupings like month and quarter align with local time.

Base Maps

Expand Advanced Configurations to see the base map stack — tile layers drawn under the event maps. Layers stack in the order listed, the first one is the bottommost. The default is Terrain at full opacity with Satellite on top at 50% opacity.

Use the up/down arrows to reorder layers, the trash icon to remove one, or Add to add another.

Fetch All Events

Pulls all turtle monitoring records from EarthRanger for the configured time range. The workflow fetches the following event types in a single query and then filters them internally:

  • (suspected) Nest — suspected nesting crawls
  • Attempt — false crawls / nesting attempts
  • Dry run — dry runs (no eggs laid)
  • Hatching Data — hatching inspections with egg counts
  • Relocation Data — relocated nest records
  • Turtle Data Form — turtle encounter records (netting, rescue, stranding, handcatch, release)

Events with no geometry are excluded. All event geometries are collapsed to point centroids so they render consistently on the maps.

After you run the workflow

Dashboard & Files

Once the configuration form has been submitted and the workflow has finished running, here's what you'll see.

Headline Stats

Five stat cards summarize the monitoring period at a glance:

  • Total Nesting Events — count of all suspected nest, attempt, and dry run events
  • Total Hatched Eggs — sum of hatched/empty egg shells across all inspected clutches
  • Hatching Success (%) — hatched eggs ÷ total eggs × 100, averaged across all inspected nests
  • Total Turtle-Related Events — count of all turtle_data_form_v2 records
  • Total Turtles with FP — count of turtle encounters where fibropapillomatosis was recorded as yes

Nesting

  • Nesting Activity Map — interactive map of suspected nests, attempts, and relocated nests, colored by event type
  • Nesting Activity Over Time — monthly bar chart of nesting counts grouped by species
  • Total Nesting Activity by Beach — table showing suspected nests, attempts, and dry runs broken down per beach
  • Nesting Success by Species & Beach — hatching success metrics (total eggs, hatched, success %) grouped by species and beach
  • Nesting Success by Nest Manipulation — hatching success grouped by manipulation type: Confirmed, Suspected, Relocated, or Surprise Nest

Turtle-Related Events

  • Turtle-Related Events Map — interactive map of all turtle encounter locations, colored by activity type (Netting, Rescue, Stranding, Nesting, Handcatch, Release)
  • Turtle Events by Location & Activity — table of encounter counts broken down by location and activity type

Fibropapillomatosis (FP) Monitoring

  • FP Monitoring by Location — table of FP cases broken down by location and activity type

Files

Switch to the Files tab to see the generated output files for the current run. Click Open Results Folder (top right) to open the folder on disk containing every saved output.

Debugging & Troubleshooting

Things that have tripped people up, and how to fix them.

Adding the workflow template doesn't seem to work

When the workflow gets stuck on Updating for quite a while, and deleting it through the app becomes difficult (the three-dot menu in the top right doesn't respond), you can delete the cached copy manually instead:

On Mac: open Finder, press Cmd + Shift + G, and paste in ~/Library/Application Support/ecoscope-desktop/data/templates.

On Windows: press Windows key + R to open the Run dialog, paste in %LOCALAPPDATA%\ecoscope-desktop\data\templates, and press Enter.

A folder window opens showing your cached templates. Find the one giving trouble (e.g. curacao-turtle_monitoring) and delete it, then go back to Ecoscope Desktop and add the workflow template again.

A widget is missing from the dashboard

Some widgets are skipped automatically when the underlying data is empty. For example, FP Monitoring by Location only appears if at least one turtle encounter had fibropapillomatosis recorded. Check the time range and confirm the relevant event types have records in EarthRanger for that period.
